title: Configuring Standard and Extended IPv4 Access Control Lists
summary: Design, configure, and verify numbered standard and named extended IPv4 Access Control Lists (ACLs) to filter traffic based on source, destination, protocol, and port numbers.
learning_objectives: Explain the difference between standard and extended ACLs and their placement rules
Configure a numbered standard ACL to restrict VTY management access
Configure a named extended ACL to permit web/DNS traffic while blocking unauthorized inter-departmental ping and file access
Apply ACLs in inbound or outbound directions using the ip access-group command
Verify ACL hit counters and matching statistics using show access-lists

source.origin: Independently authored security curriculum guide based on Cisco IOS configuration documentation
